items.q: Charlie Dixon was writing all these jazz things.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
We were doing all this stuff we had got from Fletcher and different arrangers. Charlie Dixon was writing all these jazz things.
Ella Fitzgerald had developed -- she was singing much better after the road trip. She came back, she was singing much better.
